title: The score bonus tally hit its 366/366 cap around the Kingswood's Wood Question resolution (roughly two-thirds through the run), after which resting a fourth hold, completing the Kingswood's full three-note recall, entering Marrowgate, and finishing the true ending itself all gave no visible (+N) score number -- consistent with the game's own disclaimer that the tally 'can fill long before the tale ends,' but it makes major late-game choices feel numerically unrewarded even though the epilogue text clearly still tracked them.
